note: All images are deterministic cutouts from sourced public-domain scans. No generative edits. Alpha is premultiplication-free RGBA. Anchor coordinates are measured from each PNG top-left.

cutouts.name: franklin_head
cutouts.mask_method: Manually traced silhouette polygon against source pixels; antialiasing from Lanczos resampling. No generative reinterpretation.

color_treatment.method: Original luminance mapped to restrained sepia

cutouts.notes: Recognizable engraved Franklin head with side hair and a neck/collar overlap; place above the torso. Neck anchor is inside the paper for a hidden pivot.
